content:
Apple has released its next major update for Apple Watch users: watchOS 27 is rolling out now. Here’s what’s new.

watchOS 27 adds Siri AI, new Health features, Siri modular face, Tap gesture, and more

Apple Watch users, there’s a major new software release rolling out now. watchOS 27 can be installed via the Watch app on your iPhone, but you’ll need to install iOS 27 first.

watchOS 27 drops support for a large number of previous Watch models. No longer supported are Apple Watch Ultra (1st generation), Apple Watch Series 8, Apple Watch Series 7, Apple Watch Series 6, or Apple Watch SE (2nd generation).

New in watchOS 27 you’ll find:

  • Two new apps: Siri and a consolidated Find My app
  • Siri AI, a big upgrade to the assistant that’s far more powerful
  • Tap gesture for navigating the Smart Stack
  • Dynamic App Grid as latest default Home Screen view
  • Siri Modular watch face
  • New health and fitness upgrades
  • Design updates
  • Battery optimization suggestions
  • Unfortunately, three features have been removed too

Siri AI is clearly the standout change, as the new Siri offers the same powerful assistant that’s found on iPhone in iOS 27 and Mac in macOS Golden Gate.

Rather than implementing a stripped-down version of Siri for the wrist, Apple chose to make watchOS 27’s Siri AI just as capable as on other platforms. And conversations you have with Siri on Apple Watch will sync to all your devices via the new Siri app.

Finally, Apple also says watchOS 27 should run smoother than before thanks to additional bug fixes and refinements that could impact many parts of your everyday experience.

Which new watchOS 27 features and changes are you most excited about? Let us know in the comments.
